findings.reason: I confirmed that update() reads `original` through the org-aware wrapper, whose isEnabled() is false when the linked org is disabled, while the cached ID set comes from the delegate's getAllStream search, which only filters on the IDP's own enabled flag; with both predicates false the early return skips invalidation, nothing else invalidates the login keys, and the bean re-checks only isEnabled(), so after the org is re-enabled a hidden or link-only IDP can show on the login page — real, but it needs an unusual sequence of steps.
